contact.basis: Fixed dry western bank approach beyond original NHD dam endpoint, before terrain/geometry. Crest nominal0; center foundation about-79.248m, end wing/pier tops above crest are estimates. MSLspillway elevation and Terrarium reference are distinct datums; canyon/abutment contact approximate, never fit or flatten DEM.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in native Englebright Dam original endpoint-chord frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.2m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact canyon/abutment contact classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
